title: 第15章七玄坊市出问题了第16章七玄坊市遇乱
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙

御剑归来，已是深夜。
北寒风悄无声息地回到坊市西区的小屋，体内灵力虽因初次长途御剑消耗了近半，但精神却前所未有的振奋。
百年蹉跎，黄土埋颈，何曾想过真有凭自身之力，翱翔九天的一日？
他盘膝坐床上，并未进入打坐状态，而是摩挲着腰间的红皮葫芦，心绪难平。
“十年内，必须踏入筑基！”北寒风眼中闪过一丝坚定。
唯有筑基，寿元方能大幅增长，才算真正在这修仙界有了立足的资本，也才……有资格去探寻林雪瑶的如今。
接下来的日子，北寒风的生活愈发规律。
每日完成两次例行的坊市巡逻后，他便深居简出，大部分时间都窝在小屋内修炼。
凭借红皮葫芦转化出的极品练气丹，他的修为在炼气八层稳步推进，《龟息蕴灵诀》也运转得愈发纯熟，外露的修为依旧维持在炼气二层，毫不起眼。
偶尔，他会在夜深人静时，利用驻守弟子身份离开坊市，在周边荒僻山脉中练习御剑飞行与配套的灵剑诀。
灵剑诀虽只是基础剑诀，但配合他炼气八层雄浑灵力与石肤术的强悍防御，等闲炼气九层修士，他也自信有一战之力。
这一日，北寒风巡逻至坊市南街。
此处多为散修摆摊之地，鱼龙混杂，吆喝叫卖声不绝于耳。
他例行公事地走过，目光扫过一个个摊位，多是些低阶符箓、材料、或是些来路不明、真假难辨的古旧物件。
行至一个角落的摊位时，他脚步微微一顿。
摊主是个带着斗笠、看不清面容的灰衣人，气息收敛得极好，以他炼气八层的神识竟一时难以探清深浅，估计至少也是炼气九层，甚至更高。
摊位上东西不多，几块黯淡的矿石，几张灵气微弱的符箓，以及几株保存不善、灵气流失严重的草药。
吸引北寒风目光的，是摊位角落随意丢着的一块巴掌大小、黑黢黢的金属碎片。
那碎片边缘不规则，表面布满锈蚀痕迹，看起来与凡铁无异。

但就在他扫过的瞬间，腰间一直安静的红皮葫芦，竟传来一阵温热感！
自离开废丹院，这葫芦除了转化丹药时发出温热外，并无其他异动。
此刻这突如其来的感应，让北寒风心头一跳。
他面上不动声色，如同寻常巡视般，缓步走到摊位前，目光在那金属碎片上停留一瞬，便移向旁边一株半枯的“赤精草”，沙哑开口：“这赤精草，如何卖？”
斗笠摊主抬起头，露出一双精光内敛的眼睛，在他身上扫过，声音低沉：“五块下品灵石。”
北寒风皱了皱眉，摇头：“灵气已失大半，不值这个价。”
他作势欲走。
“且慢。”摊主出声，“道友若诚心要，三块灵石拿去。”
北寒风这才停下，似在犹豫，随后目光又“不经意”地落在那黑色金属碎片上，随口问道：“这又是何物？看起来像是凡铁。”
摊主瞥了那碎片一眼，语气平淡：“不知，从一处古修士洞府外围捡的，坚硬异常，火烧不化，灵力难侵。或许是什么法器残片，或许就是块顽铁。道友若有兴趣，十块下品灵石拿走。”

It was late at night when Yu Jian returned.
Bei Hanfeng quietly returned to his hut in the West District of Fang City. Although nearly half of his spiritual power was consumed by his first long-distance sword-fighting, his spirit was as high as ever.
Hundreds of years have passed, and the loess has been buried in the neck. Have you ever thought that one day you would really be able to soar through the nine heavens with your own strength?
He sat cross-legged on the bed, not entering a meditative state, but stroking the red leather gourd around his waist, feeling uneasy.
"We must step into the foundation building within ten years!" A trace of determination flashed in Bei Hanfeng's eyes.
Only by building a foundation can one's longevity be greatly increased. Only then can one truly have the capital to establish a foothold in this world of immortality, and only then... can he be qualified to explore Lin Xueyao's current situation.
In the days that followed, Bei Hanfeng's life became more regular.
After completing two routine patrols in the city every day, he lived in seclusion and spent most of his time practicing in his hut.
With the help of the top quality Qi training pill transformed from the red-skinned gourd, his cultivation has steadily advanced at the eighth level of Qi refining, and the "Turtle Breath Containing Spirit Art" has become more and more proficient. His exposed cultivation is still at the second level of Qi refining, which is inconspicuous.
Occasionally, in the dead of night, he would use his status as a garrison disciple to leave Fang City and practice sword flying and the accompanying Spirit Sword Techniques in the surrounding remote mountains.
Although the Spiritual Sword Technique is only a basic sword technique, combined with his powerful spiritual power at the eighth level of Qi Refining and the powerful defense of the Stoneskin Technique, even a ninth-level Qi Refining monk would be confident that he would be able to fight.
On this day, Beihanfeng patrolled to Fangshi South Street.
This place is mostly a place for casual cultivators to set up stalls, with fish and dragons mixed together, and the sound of shouting and hawking is endless.
He walked by in a routine manner and glanced at each stall. Most of them contained low-level talismans, materials, or ancient objects whose origins were unknown and whose authenticity was difficult to distinguish.
When he reached a stall in a corner, he paused slightly.
The stall owner was a gray-clothed man wearing a bamboo hat, whose face could not be seen clearly. His aura was extremely restrained. With his eighth-level Qi-refining consciousness, it was difficult to detect the depth for a moment. He was probably at least the ninth-level Qi-refining level, or even higher.
There were not many things on the stall, just a few pieces of dull ore, a few talismans with weak spiritual energy, and a few poorly preserved herbs with serious loss of spiritual energy.
What caught Bei Hanfeng's attention was a palm-sized, black metal fragment thrown haphazardly in the corner of the stall.
The edges of the fragment were irregular and the surface was covered with rust marks, making it look like ordinary iron.
But the moment he swept over it, a warm feeling came from the red-skinned gourd that had been quiet around his waist!
Since leaving the Wasted Alchemy Institute, the gourd has shown no other abnormal behavior except for the warmth it emits when transforming the elixir.
This sudden feeling at this moment made Bei Hanfeng's heart skip a beat.
He had a calm expression on his face, as if he was on a regular patrol, and walked slowly to the stall. His eyes stayed on the metal fragment for a moment, then moved to a half-dried "Chi Jing grass" next to him, and said hoarsely: "How to sell this Chi Jing grass?"
The bamboo hat stall owner raised his head, revealing a pair of bright and reserved eyes, scanning him, and said in a low voice: "Five pieces of low-grade spiritual stones."
Bei Hanfeng frowned and shook his head: "Most of the spiritual energy has been lost. It's not worth the price."
He was about to leave.
"Wait a minute." The stall owner said, "If you sincerely want it, fellow Taoist, I'll take the three spiritual stones."
Bei Hanfeng stopped, as if hesitating, and then his eyes "accidentally" fell on the black metal fragments, and asked casually: "What is this? It looks like ordinary iron."
The stall owner glanced at the fragment and said in a calm tone: "I don't know, I picked it up from the outside of an ancient monk's cave. It is extremely hard, cannot be burned by fire, and cannot be penetrated by spiritual power. Maybe it is a fragment of some magic weapon, maybe it is just a piece of stubborn iron. If you are interested, fellow Taoist, take away ten low-grade spiritual stones."
